metadata.name: YouTube — AdBlock
metadata.desc: Removes ads from YouTube and YouTube Music apps

arguments.upstream: 屏蔽上传按钮:true,屏蔽选段按钮:true,屏蔽Shorts按钮:false,字幕翻译语言:off,启用调试模式:false

argumentsDesc.upstream:
- 屏蔽参数：[true, false] 
- 翻译参数：[语言代码, off] 

1. 语言代码遵循 Google Translate Languages Codes, 当填入 off 时关闭翻译
2. 开启调试模式用于输出更多日志
argumentsDesc.translated:
- Block options: [true, false] 
- Translation option: [language code, off]
